title: Remote integration proxy patterns and legal checklist for on-prem air-gapped onboarding
creator: Asha Patel
description: Problem: Enterprise customers requesting on-prem / VPC air-gapped deployments frequently surface two parallel blockers during intake: constrained network topology (no outbound egress, restrictive firewall/NAT) and legal/procurement requirements (contractual clauses needed for installer agents, proxy steps, and third-party dependencies). Current intake flows capture network readiness but don’t standardize recommended proxy integration patterns or a bundled legal checklist for legal/IT procurement alignment.\n\nGoal: Define standardized remote integration proxy patterns (customer-run proxy, vendor-bundled bastion, or controlled egress tunnel) with clear tradeoffs, a templated legal checklist for procurement, and an intake scoring update that assigns preflight lanes based on pattern fit. Deliverables: technical patterns doc, procurement checklist template, updated intake form fields, and two acceptance test scripts (connectivity + consent verification).
acceptance_criteria: Documented 3 proxy integration patterns with network diagrams and per-pattern security risk notes
Templated legal checklist accepted by Legal stakeholder (signed-off email or doc comment)
Intake form updated to include proxy pattern preference and legal constraints
Two runnable acceptance test scripts (connectivity probe and installer consent record) linked from ticket
Handbook runbook created for Solutions Engineers and Support with decision tree
